title: DnD inspired turn-based combat roguelike - Into the Shardfall
author: Ecstatic-Bend-104
selftext:
Showcasing the Bard, Druid, and Ranger (and his familiar, Rook!) in action in one my game’s twenty unique environs, as well as a few of the 500+ distinct environ-specific enemies currently implemented. 

Each expedition is split into four acts, and in each you level your party of three adventurers from Lv 1 up to 20, with subclass specialization and randomized upgrades that make each expedition different from the last. Any progression in the expedition nets currency that can be spent back in town towards meta-progression items/upgrades/unlocks.

I’ve received some great feedback from folks so far but I’m desperate for more. Try the demo on itch and give me your harshest critiques:  
[https://doublerookstudios.itch.io/into-the-shardfall](https://doublerookstudios.itch.io/into-the-shardfall)
